name: Oscar Health, Inc.
description: Oscar Health Inc is a healthcare technology company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving its members. It offers Individual & Family plans and health technology solutions that power the healthcare industry. Oscar operates as one segment to sell insurance to individuals, families and employees through the federal and state-run healthcare exchanges formed in conjunction with the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) and leverages its technology platform to provide services via its Oscar offering.
